title: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
summary: Also known as the Rudra Mantra or Tryambakam Mantra, this verse from the Rig Veda is dedicated to Shiva and is believed to promote mental, emotional, and physical health.

verses.sanskrit:
ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् |
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ||
verses.translation: We worship the three-eyed Lord (Shiva), who is fragrant and who nourishes and nurtures all beings. As is the ripe cucumber (with the intervention of the gardener) freed from its bondage (to the creeper), may He liberate us from death for the sake of immortality.
verses.transliteration:
oṃ tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭi-vardhanam
urvārukam iva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt
verses.meaning: Tryambakam - the three-eyed one; Yajamahe - we worship; Sugandhim - fragrant; Pushti - nourishment...
